description_en: Queries the 95th percentile bandwidth data of an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名95带宽峰值监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-domain-max-95-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-12T13:00:00Z --time-point 2017-12-21T10:00:00Z --cycle month --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodDomainMax95BpsData

parameters.description_en:
The domain name to be queried for acceleration. If the parameter is empty, the data merged from all accelerated domain names will be returned by default.

> Batch domain name queries are not supported.
parameters.description_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据。


> 不支持批量域名查询
